caption:
59.2 kilometres along the Guanacaste surf coast brings you into Tamarindo Bay.

From Nosara the route runs north past Ostional, San Juanillo, Marbella and Playa Negra, trading the big climbing loop for 782 metres of gain and fast coastal gravel.

The ride finishes at Hotel Capitán Suizo, beachfront at the south end of the bay. You arrive off the dirt with the hardest days of the peninsula behind you and 2 nights in the same room ahead.

Day 6 of The Gravel Expedition. Next departures 23 to 31 January 2027 and 3 to 11 July 2027. Details in the bio.
